description: SIGTERM to process exit. Matters operationally: supervisord's stopwaitsecs is 10s, and an overrun means SIGKILL mid-write.
notes: Expect a Rust win by construction rather than by optimisation: result_4 bounds shutdown with SHUTDOWN_JOIN_GRACE (2s) plus a hard backstop, engineered against that 10s limit. The reference has no such bound. Say so when reporting. Implemented in the DUT harness (benchmark/dut/xbench.py): ./tools/run_dut_bench.sh B10 --variants rust,python
